active_color.description: Color for the active window reported by each Niri workspace.
active_color.label: Active window color

fixed_height.description: Height of each workspace frame in fixed mode, in logical pixels.
fixed_height.label: Fixed height

fixed_width.description: Width of each workspace frame in fixed mode, in logical pixels.
fixed_width.label: Fixed width

floating_color.description: Color used for floating windows in compact and exact-position modes.
floating_color.label: Floating window color

floating_mode.description: Show floating windows in a compact list or at their exact Niri viewport coordinates.
floating_mode.label: Floating window mode

focused_color.description: Color for the single window holding keyboard focus.
focused_color.label: Focused window color

highlight_focused.description: Use the configured focused color for the window holding keyboard focus.
highlight_focused.label: Highlight focused window

highlight_hovered.description: Outline the window miniature currently under the pointer.
highlight_hovered.label: Highlight hovered window

hover_color.description: Border color used while hovering; focus and urgency colors take priority.
hover_color.label: Hover color

invert_scroll.description: Make scrolling down move left and scrolling up move right.
invert_scroll.label: Invert scroll direction

max_output_length.description: Maximum main-axis length of one workspace map in logical pixels.
max_output_length.label: Maximum map length

normal_color.description: Fallback color for windows without a higher-priority state.
normal_color.label: Normal window color

output_names.description: Comma-separated output names to show, for example: eDP-1, HDMI-A-1.
output_names.label: Selected outputs

output_scope.description: Show every active output, only the monitor containing this bar, or a named selection.
output_scope.label: Output scope

output_gap.description: Space between output previews in logical pixels.
output_gap.label: Output gap

preview_size.description: Cross-axis size of each output preview in logical pixels.
preview_size.label: Preview size

show_floating.description: Show floating windows beside the tiled layout.
show_floating.label: Show floating windows

show_icons.description: Show a locally resolved application icon when a miniature is large enough.
show_icons.label: Show application icons

size_mode.description: Let window geometry size the map automatically, or use a frame with explicit dimensions.
size_mode.label: Size mode

viewport_border_width.description: Thickness of the visible viewport highlight in logical pixels.
viewport_border_width.label: Viewport border width

viewport_color.description: Border color used for visible windows unless a window-state or hover color takes priority.
viewport_color.label: Viewport color

viewport_mode.description: Highlight visible windows inside the full map, add a separate viewport map, or use both.
viewport_mode.label: Visible viewport mode

window_gap.description: Space between miniature windows in logical pixels.
window_gap.label: Window gap
